items.summary: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surged 64% since late March 2026. Broadcom reported Q1 AI semiconductor revenue of $8.4B (+106% YoY) and guided Q2 AI revenue to $10.7B, targeting $100B in AI sales by 2027. Memory chips remain the most valuable commodity in the AI economy with DRAM shortages driving price increases.

news.title: Broadcom Posts Fiscal Q1 AI Semiconductor Revenue of $8.4B, Up 106% YoY; Guides Q2 to $10.7B
CME Group Launches Compute Futures Market for GPU Pricing

items.summary: Three DOE Reactor Pilot Program reactors (Aalo, Antares, Valar) received DSA approval in May 2026 and are on schedule for July 4 criticality. TerraPower's Natrium reactor received final NRC approval to begin construction in Wyoming. X-energy completed its IPO raising over $1 billion, the largest nuclear energy IPO on record, on April 24, 2026.

news.title: Three Advanced Reactors Approved for Fuel Loading; July Criticality on Track
U.S. Secures Largest-Ever HALEU Shipment from Japan - 1.7 Metric Tons

items.summary: The U.S. Navy is conducting Project Freedom operations in the Strait of Hormuz with military escorts for commercial shipping. The Air Force committed to purchasing at least seven E-7A Wedgetail aircraft, reversing prior cancellation plans. Defense budget allocations emphasize shipbuilding, munitions, Coast Guard expansion, and Golden Dome missile defense ($1.2 trillion estimate).

news.title: Air Force Plans to Buy At Least Seven E-7A Wedgetail Aircraft
U.S. Military Escorts Commercial Ships Through Hormuz Amid Iran Tensions

items.summary: Bain & Company estimates agentic AI could create a $100 billion market in the US for SaaS by automating coordination work. Deloitte forecasts 75% of companies will invest in agentic AI in 2026. IDC predicts by 2028, 70% of software vendors will shift to usage-, agent-, or outcome-based pricing models, abandoning seat-based pricing.

news.title: Bain & Company: Agentic AI to Create $100 Billion SaaS Market
Boomi Announces Strategic Collaboration with Red Hat for Agentic AI at Scale

items.summary: The Medicare GLP-1 Bridge program was extended through 2027 (updated May 11, 2026) with beneficiaries paying $50/month. Medicaid GLP-1 coverage expanded through the BALANCE Model beginning May 2026. AI-based research identified GLP-1 side effects missed in clinical trials by analyzing 400,000 Reddit posts, showing AI's role in post-market surveillance.

news.title: Medicare GLP-1 Bridge Extended Through 2027; Medicaid Expansion Begins May 2026
ChatGPT for Clinicians Launches to Support Clinical Decision-Making

items.summary: Japan Airlines deployed humanoid robots at Tokyo's Haneda Airport in May 2026 as part of a three-year operational commitment. Figure AI's humanoid robots sorted packages for 50 hours nonstop without intervention. Bessemer VC noted the industry is at 'GPT-2.5 moment for robotics' with capabilities real but production reliability gap remaining.

news.title: Figure AI Humanoid Robots Complete 50-Hour Uninterrupted Package Sorting Task
Japan Airlines Deploys Humanoid Robots at Haneda Airport in May 2026

items.summary: Copper prices hit record $14,500/tonne in January 2026 and remain near records as of mid-May. Global copper demand driven by AI data centers and electrification is expected to grow 2.6% YoY in 2026. U.S. committed $10 billion to Project Vault Strategic Critical Minerals Reserve and $1.3 billion to Reko Diq copper-gold project in Pakistan.

news.title: Copper Prices Surge Above $14,000; AI Data Centers and Electrification Drive Demand
U.S. Announces $10 Billion Project Vault Strategic Critical Minerals Reserve

items.summary: Canada announced sovereign AI infrastructure partnership with TELUS on May 11, 2026, with plans for 60,000+ GPUs and 150 MW by 2032. Red Hat and Core42 unveiled sovereign AI collaboration for UAE public sector and defense. IBM released IBM Sovereign Core enabling enterprises to deploy AI with customer control over operations and governance.

news.title: Government of Canada and TELUS Advance Sovereign AI Data Centre Initiative
Red Hat and Core42 Set Standard for Sovereign AI Infrastructure in UAE
